# Справочник API

Все интерфейсы API модов, собранные из WIT-файлов в [mod SDK](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/tree/dev/wit/blockheads-api). Моды на Lua используют тот же API через таблицу `bh`: [как имена выглядят в Lua](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/docs/luau-api.md).

Version: `blockheads:api@0.3.1`

## Интерфейсы

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [`events`](./events) | Game events with priorities and cancellation. |
| [`commands`](./commands) | Chat and console commands registered by mods. |
| [`players`](./players) | Connected players. |
| [`scheduler`](./scheduler) | Delayed and repeating tasks. |
| [`storage`](./storage) | A small per-mod, per-world key-value store. |
| [`log`](./log) | Logging to the server console or the client log. |
| [`host`](./host) | Facts about the running host and the calling mod. |
| [`services`](./services) | Cross-mod services (shape only in 0.1; implemented since 0.2; across the network since 0.3.1). |
| [`channels`](./channels) | Named byte channels between mods, and between a server mod and its client half. |
| [`guest`](./guest) | Callbacks every mod exports. |
| [`types`](./types) | Shared types used by every other interface. |
| [`content`](./content) | (0.3) Content a mod declares in `[content]` of `mod.toml` and the numeric ids the world gave it, plus cosmetics: a server mod puts one of its own cosmetics on a player and the modded clients draw it. |
| [`ui`](./ui) | Mod UI on the client (IG-HUD, IG-ModUI): HUD widgets, toasts, notices and dialogs. |
